description: Site-wide defaults used by AP Invoice Capture when promoting a capture to a Purchase Invoice. These values are not on the invoice image — they are the buyer's internal accounting decisions about which Company is purchasing, which Item to bill against, and how the spend is GL-coded.

fields.description: Used as the Company on Purchase Invoices created when promoting AP Invoice Captures. Required by the Purchase Invoice schema.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Item code applied to the single header-level line on the generated Purchase Invoice. For most pilots this is a catch-all expense item (e.g. 'AP General Expenses').
fields.label: Default Item Code

fields.description: Expense account that the Purchase Invoice line will debit when posted to the GL.
fields.label: Default Expense Account

fields.description: Cost center allocated to the Purchase Invoice line.
fields.label: Default Cost Center

fields.description: Optional. Used when the default Item is a stock item. Leave blank for pure-expense items.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Optional. Falls back to the Item's stock UOM if blank.
fields.label: Default UoM

fields.description: Which OCR provider extracts header fields from uploaded invoices. 'Fake (Deterministic)' is a hash-based stand-in for tests/dev. 'Anthropic Claude' uses the real model and requires an Anthropic API key configured in AI Provider Settings.
fields.label: OCR Provider

fields.description: Anthropic model id used for extraction. Leave blank to fall back to AI Provider Settings' default model. Pin by exact id (with date suffix) to avoid silent quality drift.
fields.label: OCR Model

fields.description: Reserved for Phase 4 (low-confidence fallback). When set, a low-confidence Haiku extraction is retried with this model. Empty disables fallback.
fields.label: OCR Fallback Model

fields.description: Per-field confidence (0–1) below which an extracted field is flagged ambiguous for human review.
fields.label: OCR Confidence Threshold

fields.description: Hard upper limit (MB) on an uploaded source file sent for extraction. Larger files are rejected with an action-required reason rather than sent to the provider.
fields.label: OCR Max File Size (MB)

fields.description: Debug only. When checked, bypasses any cross-capture dedup and forces re-extraction. Leave unchecked in production.
fields.label: Force Re-extract

fields.description: Optional per-field confidence overrides as JSON, e.g. {"total_amount": 0.9, "supplier": 0.6}. A field's effective threshold is its override here, else the OCR Confidence Threshold, else 0.70. Read via get_confidence_threshold(field).
fields.label: Per-Field Confidence Thresholds

fields.description: Stream-I auto-post / auto-approval ceiling: captures with a final total at or below this amount auto-approve; above it they route to a manager. Blank falls back to 1000.0. Replaces the former hard-coded default.
fields.label: Auto-Post Amount Threshold

fields.description: Pre-extraction duplicate detection (spec 03). The exact file-hash check always runs unless disabled; the perceptual near-duplicate check additionally needs the poppler system binary on the worker host and degrades to exact-only when it is absent.
fields.label: Deduplication

fields.description: Master switch for the pre-extraction duplicate firewall. When off, captures go straight to OCR with no dedupe check (use only for debugging).
fields.label: Enable Deduplication

fields.description: How many days back the pre-extraction duplicate check scans for a matching prior capture. Blank falls back to 90.
fields.label: Dedupe Window (Days)

fields.description: Hamming-distance threshold for a SUSPECTED perceptual near-duplicate (imagehash 64-bit pHash). A larger value flags more aggressively. Blank / non-positive falls back to 6.
fields.label: Perceptual Match Max Distance

fields.description: Master switch for the segregation-of-duties backstop (the role that coded a document cannot also approve it). Consumed by the approval step (Stream I).
fields.label: Enforce Segregation of Duties

fields.description: SoD applies to all amounts when 0; when greater than 0, SoD is enforced only above this amount.
fields.label: SoD Threshold Amount

fields.description: Credit-Card-Clearing account used by the already-paid (Stream R) PI-plus-clearing posting path. Site-wide default; the consuming step validates it against the capture's company.
fields.label: Credit Card Clearing Account

fields.description: Suspense expense account for card spend with no supplier/coding-profile match (Stream R soft path). Site-wide default; validated against the capture's company at point of use.
fields.label: Unmapped Card Spend Account

fields.description: Data-driven Receipt-vs-Invoice tagging rules (spec 02). Add rows to tune classification with no code change; lower priority is evaluated first.
fields.label: Stream Tagging Rules

fields.description: Provisional stream rules evaluated at intake by classify_stream_at_intake. First match (by priority) wins; no match leaves a capture Unclassified.
fields.label: Stream Rules

fields.description: The dedicated inbound Email Account whose received mail the Communication.after_insert hook turns into captures (channel = Email Inbound). Leave empty to keep email intake OFF.
fields.label: AP Intake Email Account

fields.description: Reserved — amount-anomaly detection parameters are filled by the validation-gates step.
fields.label: Anomaly Detection

fields.description: Reserved — bank-feed (SimpleFIN) configuration is filled by the bank-feed reconciliation step.
fields.label: Bank Feed (SimpleFIN)

name: AP Closed Loop Settings
